bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet as of 30 September 2026 shows total equity of Rs 409 Cr (up from Rs 359 Cr at 31 March 2026), funded partly through Rs 90 Cr of equity share capital issuance recorded in FY26; no dividend or buyback is mentioned anywhere in the deck.
- Growth remains working-capital and borrowing intensive: H1 FY27 net cash from operating activities was negative Rs 102 Cr, financed via proceeds from long-term borrowings (Rs 31 Cr) and short-term borrowings (Rs 114 Cr), taking current financial-liability borrowings to Rs 204 Cr (from Rs 90 Cr at March 2026).
- Net cash used in investing activities was Rs 37 Cr in H1 FY27, consistent with capex deployed on the new PEB manufacturing facility.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Described as an EPC and turnkey construction company headquartered in Chennai, established in 2013, providing end-to-end project execution across design, civil construction, pre-engineered buildings (PEB), MEP, solar installations and interior fit-outs.
- Positioned as "ONE INTEGRATED EPC PARTNER" offering single-point accountability across Design, Engineer, Procure, Construct, Commission, with the deck's value case built on better coordination/control, faster execution and an integrated supply chain versus a multi-vendor model.
- Operates across manufacturing, warehousing, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food processing, commercial infrastructure and renewable energy clients, with a diversified client portfolio; listed on the NSE in August 2024.
- Management attributes order momentum to a strong client return rate, stating "30-40% of our revenue will be fulfilled by the existing clients who are planning expand their capacities", alongside new client additions across industrial, warehousing, solar and institutional sectors.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global as an integrated, single-point-accountability EPC partner spanning design, civil, PEB, MEP, solar and interiors, now backward-integrating into its own PEB manufacturing to scale into a pan-India growth platform.
